name: GoFullPage
summary: Captures the entire scrollable page as a PNG or PDF in one click, stitching it automatically, without requesting extra permissions.
license: Proprietary on the store; the listing links the original open-source project (GitHub mrcoles/full-page-screen-capture-chrome-extension, MIT).
goodFor: Capturing the whole page as one PNG or PDF, no matter how tall.
install: Open the store page in your browser.
Choose Add to Chrome (or Add to browser) and confirm the permissions the store page lists.
Find the extension in the extensions menu (chrome://extensions in Chrome) and pin it if you want it in the toolbar.
keywords: screenshot full page capture png pdf scroll stitching
